description: Implement a function that prints "Hello, World!" (followed by a newline) to standard output. The function does not return anything.
test_code:
from main import print_hello_world


def test_print_hello_world(capsys):
    print_hello_world()
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    print("\n---------------------------------")
    print(f"Inputs: none")
    print(f"Expected: Hello, World!")
    print(f"Actual:   {captured.out}")
    assert captured.out == "Hello, World!\n"
